primitives.name: Student-t Copula SGP
primitives.verbatim_quote: **R4 (Student-t Copula SGPs)**: - Price 8 high-conviction Week 6 SGPs across active Sun/Mon games (HOU@JAX, CHI@ATL, CAR@PHI, ARI@LAR, LAC@KC, BUF@LV, DAL@GB, WSH@SF) using 50,000-draw Student-t copula simulations (`nu=4.0`) over the 1,088-game nflverse 8x8 correlation matrix (`data/snapshots/sgp_correlations.json`) with Higham (1988) nearest PSD repair.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'nu': 'degrees of freedom for Student-t (dimensionless)', 'C': 'copula function (dimensionless)', 'rho': 'correlation matrix (dimensionless)', 'P(true_copula_prob)': 'empirical copula probability (dimensionless)', 'P(independent_prob)': 'independent joint probability (dimensionless)', 'EV': 'expected value (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Correlation matrix is symmetric positive semi-definite; Student-t simulation with nu=4.0; anchor to actual DK lines.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When correlation lift or EV is non-positive or when PSD repair fails.

layer2.mapping: Copula-based joint probability of SGP outcomes isomorphic to empirical correlation structure via Higham repair.
layer2.telemetry: True copula probability vs. independent probability, EV lift.

primitives.assumptions: Fixed salary cap ($50k), 9-slot roster, zero OUT/IR/Doubtful players.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When leverage exceeds threshold or roster constraints violated.

layer2.mapping: Portfolio optimization using tabu search and field simulations to maximize EV under salary and position constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Top-3 portfolios, EV values, salary usage.

The pipeline integrates three core operators: Player Prop Projection (R3), Student-t Copula SGP (R4), and DFS Lineup Optimization (R5). The first operator maps raw DraftKings prop data to probabilistic forecasts using LogNormal tail inference, enforcing zero synthetic estimates. The second leverages a Student-t copula over a precomputed correlation matrix to price SGPs, ensuring empirical correlation lift and positive EV through Higham’s PSD repair. The third integrates these into optimized DFS lineups using tabu search and field simulations. Each operator is grounded in statistical inference and constrained by integrity checks to prevent cheating or synthetic outputs. Failure modes include tied conviction scores, non-positive EVs, or invalid correlations.
